full_track.tags: K-pop duet, mid-tempo emotional pop with full instrumental backing — piano, warm synth pad, soft 808 and clap beat. 92 BPM, key of C major. Two clearly distinct lead voices that alternate and stay identifiable, blending only in the chorus: Voice 1 is a bright, clear young female with a light head voice; Voice 2 is a warm, husky male baritone with a soft chesty tone. Verses trade line by line in a call-and-response format — the female sings a line, the male answers. The pre-chorus stacks the two in close two-part harmony. The final chorus opens in unison then splits into a third-apart harmony. Keep the two timbres separated and identifiable throughout — do not merge them into one voice. Korean lyrics, intimate and encouraging mood, late-night phone-call warmth.
